text: I can say whether a quantization scheme (weight-only INT4, W8A8, FP8, FP8 KV cache) speeds up prefill, decode or concurrency, and compute the weight bytes including group-scale overhead.
I can design a quality gate for a quantized model using task-sliced evals against the full-precision baseline instead of perplexity alone.
I can explain how FlashAttention's tiling and online softmax avoid writing the N × N score matrix to HBM while staying exact.
I can compute KV bytes per token for MHA, GQA and MQA from a published model shape and turn it into concurrent sequences per GPU.
I can work out the prefill compute saved by prefix caching at a given hit rate and name what makes the hit rate collapse.
I can pick a chunked-prefill token budget from a TPOT target and say when disaggregating prefill and decode is worth the KV transfer.
